summary: Published DEB, RPM, AppImage, and Pacman packages from source commit d1665f13. The release adds the Quansheng TK11 OEM login/session flow before uploads, decodes and writes TK-350 5 kHz channels by their step bits and writes CTCSS tones, and makes UV-5RM Pro/5RH Pro announce at 19200 first while skipping stray bytes before the sync acknowledgement as the v1.12 CPS does. Verification: flutter analyze passed; all 257 Flutter tests passed with the bundled Python 3.13 runtime; 701 bundled Python tests passed with two fixture-dependent skips; the Ubuntu 20.04 ABI check passed with maximum GLIBC 2.18; DEB, RPM, and Pacman metadata and embedded version 1.0.79 were verified; DEB and AppImage Xvfb smoke tests passed; the AppImage launched under host Wayland and X11; package payloads include the TK11, TK-350, and UV-5RM Pro changes and omit GLVND/EGL/GLES loaders; all public downloads returned HTTP 200; and the Linux platform manifest reports 1.0.79. Package SHA-256 values: a6864bd263e2b32b15cc66dd76f164c86ee2bb7426a62fb069e65f8290a6f64f, 3e349d34dbcf5ccf185e6ac6baf201bdfde4f3f96e9da87cef4299c3bfd7e50f, 306aecb74cff4af8c3d4b3df2170a3928b9689fa8eeb68e35de0eecb729353a6, and 6190fa6a17e928b68b4de5b15f00fe44c30c24c782cf1bcbc46c64c8d9bd0804.
